title: Cap. 1 prol. IV: works foresight and faith foresight as distinguishers
pass_a_gloss: So also, if anyone should defend that those alone are elected unto glory whom God foresees adorned with merits or good works unto the end of their life, and that those alone are reprobated or not-elected whom he foresees perseveringly clinging to demerits or evil works, that person places foresight works, according as they were good or evil, as distinguishing conditions, for whose difference different acts of Divine predestination and reprobation befit diverse humans. Likewise, if anyone should teach that God elects those alone whom he foresees will persevere in faith, and passes by and rejects those alone whom he foresees will persevere in unbelief, that person constitutes this faith and unbelief as distinguishing conditions, for whose discrimination distinct acts of predestination and reprobation fall upon distinct persons. Key lemmas: praevisa opera (foresight works); merita / demerita; fides / infidelitas; perseverare.
pass_b_english: So too if someone maintains that only those are elected to glory whom God foresees clothed with merits or good works to the end of life, and that only those are reprobated or not elected whom he foresees clinging perseveringly to demerits or evil works — then that person makes foresight works, good or evil, into distinguishing conditions, and by their difference different Divine acts of predestination and reprobation are assigned to different people. Likewise if someone teaches that God elects only those he foresees will persevere in faith, and passes by and rejects only those he foresees will persevere in unbelief — then faith and unbelief become the distinguishing conditions by whose discrimination the distinct acts of predestination and reprobation fall on distinct persons.
source_text: Sic etiam, si quis tueatur illos solos eligi ad gloriam, quos Deus praevidet meritis sive bonis operibus ornatos usque ad finem vitae suae, atque eos solos reprobari sive non-eligi, quos praevidet demeritis sive malis operibus perseveranter adhaerescentes, is praevisa opera, prout bona fuerint vel mala, ponit conditiones distinguentes, pro quarum differentia differentes actus Divinae praedestinationis & reprobationis diversis hominibus conveniunt. Item, si quis doceat Deum illos solos eligere quos praevidet perseveraturos in fide, illos solos praeterire & rejicere quos praevidet perseveraturos in infidelitate, is hanc fidem & infidelitatem constituit conditiones distinguentes, pro quarum discrimine distincti actus praedestinationis & reprobationis cadunt in distinctas personas.
